{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially when sentiment is neutral or negative).",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if sentiment is consistently negative over recent days.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias when price is trading far above/below 30-day moving average.",
    "Lower forecast for early-morning sessions if sentiment is weak or negative.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low sentiment periods (e.g., sentiment < 0.00) to avoid underestimating downside risk.",
    "Correct for lagged reactions: if true outcome is significantly lower than forecast, reduce next period’s forecast by 5–10% to account for delayed market response.",
    "When sentiment is positive but price is trending down, reduce forecast slope to avoid overcorrection.",
    "Use sentiment as a filter: if sentiment > 0.33, allow slight upward bias; if sentiment < -0.20, apply downward bias with higher magnitude."
  ]
}
